data.title: Health and care insurance contribution notice from 1 October 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK informs you that your monthly health and long-term care insurance contribution rises from €146.29 to €156.55 from 1 October 2026. The new amount is first debited on 15 October 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer (Muster BKK) has recalculated your student contribution because the BAföG-based monthly need rose to €915.00 from the 2026/27 winter semester. Your total is now €156.55 per month, debited on the 15th of each month. You may object (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer; the app shows the deadline. An objection does not pause payment, so you must keep paying the new amount meanwhile. If unsure about the calculation, ask the insurer or a counselling service.

items.title: Objection to contribution notice
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person with Muster BKK.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final. An objection does not suspend payment.

items.title: Monthly health and care insurance contribution
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag wie bisher zum 15. eines Monats ab, den neuen Betrag erstmals am 15.10.2026.
items.action: Make sure your account holds enough funds for the direct debit of the new amount on the 15th of each month.
